2607.07521.title: Creativity from Friction: Human-AI Interaction for Exploratory Structural Design
2607.07521.paper_summary: AI agents that generate final answers based on user input often do not meet the needs of creative fields. Fields such as structural design and architecture need interactive systems that help users externalise and develop ideas, explore alternatives, and refine partial solutions. The final product of such designs needs to comply with many constraints concerning, e.g., spatial configuration, mechanical behaviour, material quantities, and costs. These constraints create friction in the design process, which can stimulate novel and creative solutions. In this paper, we discuss the misalignment between current generative AI goals to remove friction and provide final solutions and the needs of creators, such as structural designers, who develop ideas through iterative work. We present the design dimensions of systems allowing for constrained human-AI co-creation that rely on vision-language models making structural exploration conversational, multimodal, and responsive to evolving human intent in ways that follow and augment the discipline's creative process. Through a pilot design interface based on these principles and a study with experts in the field, this paper shows how structural designers perceive interactive AI systems and how such systems can support design space exploration by reducing repetitive modelling friction while preserving reflective design friction.
2607.07521.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理人根據用戶輸入生成最終答案，通常無法滿足創意領域的需求。<lb/>結構設計和建築等領域需要互動系統，幫助用戶外化和發展想法、探索替代方案並完善部分解決方案。<lb/>這些設計的最終產品需要遵循許多約束條件，例如空間配置、機械行為、材料數量和成本。<lb/>這些約束在設計過程中產生摩擦，這可以激發新穎和創造性的解決方案。<lb/>在本文中，我們討論了當前生成性 AI 目標之間的錯位，即消除摩擦和提供最終解決方案，以及創作者的需求，例如通過迭代工作發展想法的結構設計師。<lb/>我們提出了允許受限人機共同創作的系統設計維度，這些系統依賴於視覺-語言模型，使結構探索變得對話式、多模態，並對不斷演變的人類意圖作出響應，以符合並增強該學科的創造過程。<lb/>通過基於這些原則的試點設計界面和與該領域專家的研究，本文展示了結構設計師如何看待互動 AI 系統，以及這些系統如何通過減少重複建模摩擦來支持設計空間探索，同時保留反思性設計摩擦。
